subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared agent-facing inbound attachment metadata contract now, or continue representing Slack attachments through placeholders and legacy Media* fields for this release?
rationale: The missing data is clear in source, but the durable fix changes the shared channel/plugin SDK context shape and needs maintainer API direction before implementation.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Introduce a cross-channel structured attachment field and map Slack, Discord, and Telegram metadata while preserving legacy Media* and placeholder behavior.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document the placeholder/download-file workflow as the supported Slack attachment path and defer structured metadata.

options.title: Prototype Slack Only
options.body: Add a narrow Slack field first, accepting future migration risk if sibling channels need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a cross-channel structured attachment field and map Slack, Discord, and Telegram metadata while preserving legacy Media* and placeholder behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion routed the API question to this person and local blame ties them to the current media-context definitions in the checked-out history.
